result.title: When Pairwise Preferences Cycle: A Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk for Video GRPO
result.summary: Pairwise preference feedback has become a widely adopted supervision signal for reinforcement learning in video generation models, as pairwise comparisons provide a more reliable alternative than pointwise scalar ratings for evaluating the quality of generated videos. Specifically, we define a preference graph for each GRPO group under a pairwise evaluator, where nodes represent sampled rollouts and edges encode pairwise preferences. Auditing 6,976 on-policy comparison graphs, we find that cyclic preferences are prevalent and persist throughout training. Naive pairwise reward aggregation based on average win rates discards the underlying comparison structures and treats each rollout independently, which may introduce unreliable advantage estimates for certain rollouts and consequently affect reinforcement learning optimization. Therefore, we propose the \emph{Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk} (\ours{}), a graph-aware advantage aggregation method that strengthens the global preference signal from win rates with reliable relational evidence from cyclic preference graphs through a reliability-guided preference walk. Under matched evaluator, comparison protocol, group size, prompt schedule, and query budget, \ours{} requires no additional evaluator queries beyond the observed comparisons within each rollout group and improves over Pairwise-GRPO across controlled comparisons, transfer settings, and blind human evaluations.

AI.brief_summary: 论文审计视频生成模型 GRPO 中成对偏好比较形成的偏好图，发现循环偏好普遍且持续存在，并提出 Reliability-Anchored Preference Walk：用可靠性引导的偏好游走将成对胜率与循环图中的关系证据结合，做图感知的优势聚合。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是视频生成而非 VLM 推理，但「循环/不一致的成对偏好会破坏优势估计」及可靠性加权的图感知聚合，可能为 LVR 中多假设或多轨迹间的贡献分配与偏好监督提供可核查的方法线索。
